```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(tidyverse); library(knitr)
```

## 1. Load Data
```{r}
df <- read.csv("../data/stylistic_asymmetry_complete_dataset.csv")
df$Tradition <- factor(df$Tradition, levels=c("Western","Postcolonial","Persian"))
df$Type <- factor(df$Type, levels=c("Human","GPT-4o"))
head(df)
```

## 2. Descriptive Table
```{r}
df %>% group_by(Tradition, Type) %>% summarise(
  N = n(),
  MATTR = sprintf("%.3f \u00b1 %.3f", mean(MATTR), sd(MATTR)),
  Burrows_Delta = sprintf("%.3f \u00b1 %.3f", mean(Burrows_Delta), sd(Burrows_Delta)),
  MLS = sprintf("%.2f \u00b1 %.2f", mean(MLS), sd(MLS)),
  HLR = sprintf("%.2f \u00b1 %.2f", mean(HLR), sd(HLR)),
  .groups = "drop") %>% kable()
```
